thread:
ana: Heads-up: customer reported failures when redwood-hsm-plugin binds a UNIX socket in /tmp on RHEL9 with SELinux=Enforcing + systemd PrivateTmp. Raising a docs PR with a short migration path and air-gap notes: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4699

tyler: can you paste the AVC denial snippet so we capture the exact context?

ana: pasted in PR but here
re a short AVC line: `May 10 08:12:01 host audit[2100]: AVC avc:  denied  { open } for pid=2100 comm="redwood-hsm-plugin" name="pkcs11.sock" scontext=system_u:system_r:redwood_t:s0 tcontext=unconfined_u:object_r:tmp_t:s0 tclass=unix_stream_socket`

jean: recommended doc fixes: 1) prefer persistent dir under /var/lib/redwood/hsm-socket + set file context and run restorecon at install time; 2) fallback: systemd override to disable PrivateTmp for the unit. include semanage example in Advanced section only.

tyler: add AppArmor note for Ubuntu: add `/var/lib/redwood/hsm-socket/*` to the hsm profile and reload with `apparmor_parser -r`.

ana: added a tiny migration script in the PR to detect legacy /tmp sockets and move them (keeps commands minimal for air-gapped sites). docs-bot: CI link-check failed due to an internal KB URL; removed placeholder.

docs-bot: Link-check: fail in PR 4699 - internal KB link updated, mark for manual approval.

jean: security requested we avoid suggesting `setenforce 0`. added a short "do not disable SELinux" note.

tyler: LGTM, I'll run the airgap smoke test on a RHEL9 VM later. leaving thread for test results and copyedit.
